name: Microsoft 365 GCC High (starter template)
description: Starting split for a small supplier using Microsoft 365 GCC High (Entra ID, Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, Intune, Defender and Purview) as the CUI environment, with endpoints managed by Intune.
disclaimer: This is a starting point only, not Microsoft's own matrix. Reconcile every row against Microsoft's current CMMC and NIST SP 800-171 customer responsibility documentation for your licensing and services, and remember that inheritance applies only where the GCC High authorization boundary actually covers the CUI. On-premises endpoints, shop-floor equipment, paper and people are never covered by the tenant.

rows.customer_responsibility: Configure the tenant settings (Conditional Access, Intune policies, Purview labels, Defender policies, audit retention), apply them to every in-scope endpoint and account, and export the configuration and reports as evidence.
